item.description:
# Shruti 1.4.2
- Gives Shruti its own `ShrutiService` executable, singleton lock, control socket and logs. - Removes Sangam service startup, shutdown and packaging from every Shruti shipping path. - Keeps each engaged app inside its own sacrificial tap worker while the main service stays responsive. - Adds a release gate that rejects any future runtime or installer coupling to Sangam. - Shows only apps with real or recent output activity (or an active control), removing idle SoundSource imports such as Terminal, Wispr Flow and ScreenFlow from the live mixer. - Adds drag-free Move Up/Move Down device ordering and a Frequently Used section backed by durable output, input and alert-route history. - Adds safe Remove and Restore for physical audio devices without uninstalling macOS drivers; a current system route must be changed before it can be removed. - Keeps audio-app discovery playback-focused, so microphone permission or a video category alone no longer puts recording and dictation tools in the Add App list.
